reason: E-Golf4U is going away and I have to pick something my board can defend for the next ten years, not a two-person startup that no club runs yet. A free pilot is nice, but running two systems side by side with 950 mostly older members costs us volunteer time and goodwill, and if it fails we have lost months we don't have.
objection: No other club uses it yet: where are the references? Two founders carrying the members, tee times and invoicing of a club our size is a continuity risk, contract clause or not.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, with its board telling me on the phone that tee times, invoicing and the older members all went smoothly, plus a second club of our size on board.
